description.en: Trending copy-paste animated components and hero sections for modern web.
description.zh: 极具未来感与视觉张力的潮流 React 动效组件库，主打粒子背景与酷炫 Hero。

content.en: Aceternity UI is an influential collection of visually striking, copy-paste animated React components created by Manu Arora. Known for pushing the boundaries of web motion with Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS, and Three.js, it offers 3D pin cards, lamp hero effects, canvas reveal masks, and glowing sparkles.
content.zh: Aceternity UI 是由 Manu Arora 打造的现象级现代 React 动效组件库。全库以极具未来感、暗黑科技风与强视觉冲击力著称，完美融合了 Framer Motion、Tailwind CSS 与 Three.js 着色器技术，包含天顶灯光 Hero、3D 悬浮卡片、Canvas 动态揭幕与多维粒子流光等前沿视觉效果。
